worldcombat.skill.furyattack.summary: Plant your feet and jab a horn or beak into one point again and again; each jab shoves the target back, and once it is out of reach the string ends. The shove form stays rooted and pushes the target away; the chase form follows in and lands the whole string.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.use.0: Plant your feet and jab a point with horn or beak over and over
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.use.1: Each jab shoves the target, driving it out of range
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.use.2: Chase form follows the target and lands the whole string
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.description: Each jab deals about %1$s contact damage (Attack-driven); up to %2$s jabs per string, each at %3$s accuracy. One miss or a target shoved out of reach ends the string.
Jab reach %1$s blocks, tip half-width %2$s blocks, each jab shoves the target %3$s blocks, %4$s between jabs.
In the chase form each jab advances %1$s blocks; each jab hits up to %2$s targets.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.close.on: Chase form: follow in after each jab to hold the target in reach, landing the whole string more often; the cost is a lighter jab that barely shoves.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.close.off: Shove form: stay rooted, each jab heavier and shoving farther, driving the target away; the cost is that it is shoved out of reach and the string ends early.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.growth.0: At level %1$s, each jab rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.growth.1: At level %1$s, each jab %2$s and jab reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.furyattack.growth.2: At level %1$s, each jab %2$s and shove %3$s blocks.
On (chase): follow in after each jab to hold the target in reach, landing the whole string more often; the cost is x0.9 per jab and x0.35 shove, barely pushing anyone. Off (shove, native): stay rooted, x1.2 shove and x1.05 per jab, driving the target away; the cost is that it is shoved out of reach and the string ends early.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of starting the jabs.
On: targets that are barely moving (pinned, walled in, standing still) rank higher because the whole string lands on them; running targets rank lower. Off: all targets rank the same.
On: under a hold order it will still leave its post to jab; off: only casts when the target is already in reach.
world_combat.move.furyattack.text.out: Shoved out of reach; %1$s jabs landed
